## Units {#sec-units}

Numbers are from the game's prototypes, before research. Damage is one shot. A corporation's research raises its
weapons' damage, and its armor research adds resistance to some units. *Hits air* says whether the unit's weapon
can touch a flying unit. Speed is in tiles a second, range in tiles and rate in shots a second. Corporations pay
for units in parts, Synthexis in biomass, and you in command bandwidth.

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-laser-drone.png){fig-alt="Laser drone"}

**Laser drone.** An armored flying drone with a laser. Resists bullets. \
*A shot:* 12 laser. *Resists:* fire 100%, physical -3 40%, laser 20%. *Fielded:* From its level 2.
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-railgunner.png){fig-alt="Railgunner"}

**Railgunner.** Clears biter spawners. Its slug pierces a few biters and stops: 250 to spawners, worms, incubators and tumors, 40 to biters on their feet, 10 to anything else; Kessler-Hayashi's railguns research raises both (+60% a level). \
*A shot:* 250 physical over 0.5 tiles; 40 physical over 0.5 tiles; 10 physical over 0.5 tiles. *Resists:* physical -2 10%, laser 20%. *Fielded:* From landing.
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-tank.png){fig-alt="Tank"}

**Tank.** An armored tank. Its cannon does three times as much damage to buildings as to units. \
*A shot:* 40 explosion; 80 explosion over 1.5 tiles to buildings. *Resists:* physical -3 20%, fire 60%, explosion -5 30%, laser -5, electric -5, bite 60%. *Fielded:* From landing.
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-skyguard.png){fig-alt="Anti-air trooper"}

**Anti-air trooper.** A trooper with a long-range laser against flying units. Weak against ground targets. \
*A shot:* 30 laser over 1 tiles; 8 laser over 0.5 tiles. *Resists:* physical -2 10%, laser 20%. *Fielded:* Research: Anti-air troopers (Line, era 1).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-lance.png){fig-alt="Heavy laser trooper"}

**Heavy laser trooper.** A laser trooper with a heavier beam that outranges your troopers. \
*A shot:* 24 laser. *Resists:* physical -2 10%, laser 20%. *Fielded:* Research: Heavy laser troopers (Optics, era 1).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-shock.png){fig-alt="Shock trooper"}

**Shock trooper.** Its electric beam jumps from target to target and stuns them briefly. Used against groups of troopers. \
*A shot:* (arcs to the next targets); 10 electric. *Resists:* physical -2 10%, laser 20%, electric 50%. *Fielded:* Research: Shock troopers (Optics, era 3, after Heavy laser troopers).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-aegis.png){fig-alt="Heavy tank"}

**Heavy tank.** A heavy tank with a rail cannon. Its slug ignores armor; used against your battle tanks. \
*A shot:* 38 rail. *Resists:* physical -5 30%, explosion -5 40%, laser -5, electric -5, bite 60%. *Fielded:* Research: Heavy tanks (Line, era 2, after Heavier armor).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-prism.png){fig-alt="Laser tank"}

**Laser tank.** A tank whose laser splits from its target to the units around it. Used against groups of troopers. \
*A shot:* (arcs to the next targets); 10 laser; 14 laser. *Resists:* physical -3 20%, laser -5, electric -5, explosion 10%, bite 60%. *Fielded:* Research: Laser tanks (Optics, era 2, after Heavy laser troopers).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-tesla.png){fig-alt="Lightning tank"}

**Lightning tank.** A tank whose lightning jumps along a turret line and drains the turrets it hits. \
*A shot:* (arcs to the next targets); 10 electric; 20 electric. *Resists:* physical -3 20%, electric -5 80%, explosion 10%, laser -5, bite 60%. *Fielded:* Research: Lightning tanks (Siege, era 3).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-howitzer-truck.png){fig-alt="Howitzer truck"}

**Howitzer truck.**  \
*A shot:* 4 physical. *Resists:* physical -4 30%, fire 50%, explosion 20%. *Fielded:* Carries the howitzer to a siege.
:::

**Buggy.** A fast buggy with a machine gun. Grubstake's raider and escort. \

![](media/units/lp-grubstake-harrier.png){fig-alt="Scrap drone"}

*A shot:* 6 physical. *Resists:* fire 100%. *Fielded:* From its level 1.
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-shotgun-hand.png){fig-alt="Shotgun hand"}

**Shotgun hand.** Grubstake's soldier, with a shotgun. Deadly up close, useless against a turret line. \
*A shot:* 9 physical (x3). *Resists:* physical -2 10%. *Fielded:* From landing.
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-grubstake-slug.png){fig-alt="Slug buggy"}

**Slug buggy.** A buggy with a slug gun, used against your vehicles. \
*A shot:* 55 physical. *Resists:* physical -2 15%, explosion 40%. *Fielded:* Research: Slug buggies (Scrap arms, era 1).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-grubstake-sapper.png){fig-alt="Dynamite sapper"}

**Dynamite sapper.** Throws dynamite over 3 tiles, at groups of units and at walls in its way. Spares its own side. \
*A shot:* 80 explosion over 3 tiles. *Resists:* physical -2 10%. *Fielded:* Research: Dynamite sappers (Scrap arms, era 2).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-grubstake-scavenger.png){fig-alt="Bomb drone"}

**Bomb drone.** A flying bomb that targets artillery, mortars and radars. \
*A shot:* 150 explosion; 150 explosion over 2.5 tiles. *Resists:* fire 100%. *Fielded:* Research: Bomb drones (Wheels, era 2).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-grubstake-dozer.png){fig-alt="Dozer"}

**Dozer.** Rams walls open for the shotgun hands behind it. \
*A shot:* 60 physical. *Resists:* physical -5 40%, fire 50%, explosion -5 20%, laser -5, electric -5, bite 60%. *Fielded:* Research: Dozers (Wheels, era 3, after Slug buggies).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-grubstake-flak-buggy.png){fig-alt="Flak buggy"}

**Flak buggy.** Fires flak at flying units. Weak against ground targets. \
*A shot:* 22 explosion over 2 tiles; 3 explosion over 1.5 tiles. *Resists:* physical -2 15%. *Fielded:* Research: Flak buggies (Wheels, era 1).
:::

::: {.unit-entry layout="[14,-2,84]" layout-valign="top" fig-pos="H"}
![](media/units/lp-grubstake-scorcher.png){fig-alt="Flame tank"}

**Flame tank.** An old tank hull with a machine gun and a flamethrower that fires three bursts, then reloads slowly. \
*A shot:* 6 physical. *Resists:* physical -3 25%, fire 100%, explosion -5 30%, laser -5, electric -5, bite 60%. *Fielded:* Research: Flame tanks (Scrap arms, era 2).
:::

**Synthexis big burster.** A huge biter that bursts at the nearest turret, damaging all turrets nearby. \
*A shot:* 90 bite. *Resists:* laser 50%, fire 50%. *Fielded:* Developed once your walls have held its waves 2 times.

*A shot:* 7 bite. *Fielded:* Made at an incubator for each wave.
:::

**Synthexis sweeper.** Bursts in minefields to clear a path before an attack. \
*A shot:* 30 bite. *Resists:* physical -8 10%, explosion 10%. *Fielded:* Bred when a wave's way in crosses mines.

**Synthexis carrier.** Carries a new Synthexis culture to wild spawners. \
*A shot:* 30 bite. *Resists:* physical -8 10%, explosion 10%. *Fielded:* Sent by a grown culture.

**Synthexis technician.** Walks between the biochambers and keeps them running. \
*A shot:* 1 physical. *Resists:* physical -2 10%. *Fielded:* Bought with biomass as the culture grows.
